hints.title: Pre-Labeling Connected Masses
hints.text: Precalculate the area of each connected land mass with distinct identifiers before checking empty cells.

hints.title: Neighboring Island Unions
hints.text: For each zero cell, sum the areas of distinct neighboring island identifiers plus one for the converted bridge cell.

hints.title: Global Maximum Bridge
hints.text: Color each island with a unique tag >= 2 and map tag to component area. Iterate over all 0s, deduplicate adjacent tags, and return the maximum merged size.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Two-pass algorithm: DFS flood fill followed by constant-time neighbor lookups per zero.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing flood fill for every 0 cell takes O(N^4) time and causes timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grid labels and island area dictionary require O(N^2) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use unique island tags (starting at 2) in-place to avoid separate visited arrays.
